goals.title: Every fix in the Kick/YouTube overlay carries INDEPENDENT evidence. The static gate is green (checks=15 failed=0) but it still reports FIXED, NOT VERIFIED for KO-20261023-01 and KO-20261026-04, and 3 items NOT MEASURED. This goal is finished when each of those two bugs either gains a measured negative arm (FIXED + VERIFIED with evidence in _evidence/) or is explicitly reverted, and the remaining NOT MEASURED items are the ones that genuinely need the owner's own Chrome. Falsifier: the gate's receipt must contain no 'FIXED, NOT VERIFIED' line.
done_when: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "node 'I:\kicktwitchyoutube_instagram\_tools\ko-verify.mjs' *> 'G:\Temp\opencode\ko-goal-gate.txt'; if (Select-String -Path 'G:\Temp\opencode\ko-goal-gate.txt' -Pattern 'FIXED, NOT VERIFIED' -Quiet) { Write-Host 'still unverified'; exit 1 } elseif (Select-String -Path 'G:\Temp\opencode\ko-goal-gate.txt' -Pattern 'RESULT PASS' -Quiet) { Write-Host 'all verified'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'gate did not run'; exit 2 }"
